title: subagent: Find when Aquinas image added to Wikipedia

content:
I need to find when a picture of St. Thomas Aquinas was first added to the Wikipedia page on the "Principle of double effect". 

The Wikipedia URL is: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Principle_of_double_effect

Please use webfetch and websearch to:
1. Visit the Wikipedia page and look at the page history
2. Visit the page history at https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Principle_of_double_effect&action=history
3. Look through the edit history to find when an image of St. Thomas Aquinas was first added
4. Also try searching for the image upload date

Return the exact date (DD/MM/YYYY format) when the image of St. Thomas Aquinas was first added to this article.
I'll help you find when the image of St. Thomas Aquinas was first added to the Wikipedia page. Let me start by fetching the page and its history.
